sections.section_title: ADC analog watchdog 3 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD3LTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 32.6.25 "ADC analog watchdog 3 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD3LTR)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1564.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0B8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:0 LTR[22:0]: Analog watchdog 3 lower threshold
These bits are set and cleared by software to define the lower threshold for analog watchdog 3.
Refer to Analog windows watchdog section.
